message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: illegal occupation of forest land, destroying forest resources, changing land use, causing damage to forest. This corresponds to crime of "非法占用林地、破坏森林资源" which under Chinese criminal law is "非法占用林地罪" or "破坏森林资源罪". The typical charge is "非法占用林地罪" (Article 338 of Criminal Law) or "破坏森林资源罪" (Article 338 also). Actually Article 338: "非法占用林地、破坏森林资源的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the crime is "非法占用林地罪" or "破坏森林资源罪". In examples, they used "滥伐林木" for illegal logging. Here it's illegal occupation and destruction of forest land. Could be "非法占用林地罪". The answer format: [罪名]非法占用林地罪<eoa> or maybe "破坏森林资源罪". Which one is more appropriate? The description: "非法占用林地，改变土地用途，造成林地大量毁坏". That matches "非法占用林地罪". So answer: [罪名]非法占用林地罪<eoa>
